name: test_send_offer_email_broker_accepts_then_document_upload_notifies_broker_and_uw
description:
Objective: Send offer email broker accepts then document upload notifies broker and uw.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA is available at the exact configured origin; use a fresh browser context, the configured authorized test account, and isolated automation-owned data. The exact state-specific URL/fixture required by the test is configured; absence fails the test. The Notification Control Panel is set to Dev; all recipients are allowlisted; real delivery is explicitly enabled when the case sends email.
Steps:
1. Satisfy the stated QA, role, seed, recipient and isolation preconditions before any mutation.
2. Authenticate with the configured authorized test user and navigate to Offer / Broker review / Offer history.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Execute the page/API action `broker_offer.select_commission_points` (select commission points).
5. Execute the page/API action `broker_offer.accept_offer` (accept offer).
6. Execute the page/API action `notification_client.wait_for_broker_complete_requirements_link` (wait for broker complete requirements link).
7. Execute the page/API action `notification_client.wait_for_uw_offer_accepted_application_link` (wait for uw offer accepted application link).
8. Execute the page/API action `requirements_page.goto` (goto).
9. Execute the page/API action `requirements_page.fill_business_legal_name` (fill business legal name).
10. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `'Complete Requirements' in broker_requirements_email.body_text`; `'View Application' in uw_offer_accepted_email.body_text`; `'Requirements Submitted Successfully' in broker_confirmation.body_text`; `'View Application' in uw_requirements_email.body_text`.
11. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Send offer email broker accepts then document upload notifies broker and uw.
2. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `'Complete Requirements' in broker_requirements_email.body_text`; `'View Application' in uw_offer_accepted_email.body_text`; `'Requirements Submitted Successfully' in broker_confirmation.body_text`; `'View Application' in uw_requirements_email.body_text`.
3. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
